additions.prior_state: 2025년 9월 중국 승용차 제조사 판매량 가운데 수출 비중은 19%였고, 북미 전기차 시장에는 2025년 9월 미국 구매세액공제 종료 직전의 높은 구매기준이 있었다. 2026년 9월과 동일한 집계 범위의 비교다.
additions.new_verified_fact: 2026년 9월 세계 EV 판매 215만대(−2% YoY, +17% MoM), 유럽 60만대(+39%)·북미 −44%, 중국 승용 NEV 소매 108.4만대(−16.7%)·수출 55.8만대(+163.5%); 승용차 제조사 판매 대비 전체 수출 비중 36%(전년 19%)와 승용차 수출 내 NEV 비중 60.8%(+21%p) 구분, MIIT 전체 자동차 NEV 판매 182.3만대(+13.6%).
additions.changed_judgment: 2026년 9월 중국 승용차 제조사 판매 중 전체 승용차 수출 비율 36%(전년 19%)와 승용차 수출 내부 NEV 비중 60.8%(+21%포인트)는 서로 다른 지표지만 모두 해외 판매 채널의 변화에 관한 근거다. 반면 승용 NEV 국내 소매는 −16.7%다. 중국 내수·수출·전체 자동차 NEV 판매를 구분해 배터리 셀·소재 수요를 해석해야 하며 실제 조달·가동률·판매단가·마진 영향은 후속 출하·재고·기업 실적으로 확인해야 한다.
additions.evidence_review_summary: R32 2026-10-17 original-source audit; manual six-dimensional Deep Summary editorial review (NOT formal Prompt 0.6 V5). ① prior state: September 2025 China passenger-car manufacturer export/sales share 19%, 2025 US federal EV credit expiry pre-deadline North American comparison; removed earlier unsupported August +2%/-11% baselines. ② changed state: September 2026 China overall passenger-car export/sales share 36% and passenger export NEV composition 60.8% (+21pp), separately from global EV -2% and China passenger NEV domestic retail -16.7%. ③ quantitative: Benchmark 2.15m global Sept EV (-2% YoY, +17% MoM), 15.5m YTD (+3%), Europe nearly 600k (+39%), NA -44%; CADA passenger NEV domestic retail 1.084m (-16.7%) and export 558k (+163.5%), MIIT all-auto NEV 1.823m (+13.6%). ④ boundary: Chinese domestic passenger retail, passenger manufacturer exports, all passenger-car exports, passenger maker total sales, national all-auto NEV sales and global EV sales have DIFFERENT denominators, and NA -44% reflects 2025 credit-expiry high base; no realized cell margins claimed. ⑤ transmission: exporter channel share and NEV mix shift can alter supply allocation, cell/material sourcing and cost competition, but actual contracts and profits remain conditional. ⑥ watchpoint: following month's China passenger domestic retail/export/share, whole-auto NEV, geographic EV growth, cell utilization and real supplier financials. Claim-to-quote readback: Benchmark literal YTD+3%, record Europe ~600k, North America 2025 US credit baseline; CADA literal passenger export 917k and manufacturer export 36% (2025:19%), passenger export NEV composition 60.8% (+21pp); MIIT literal national total cars and passenger+commercial breakdown. Materiality distinct: A20 = two documented export-channel structural-share measures (19→36% maker export penetration and NEV composition 60.8%/+21pp) WITHOUT re-crediting Europe/NA/China unit growth; B25 = observed sales/exports volumes and YoY rates; D3 = source-attributed qualitative export-support effect without claiming company margin; persistence1 = a one-month data observation, follow-through unproven. No owner override or fabricated source quote; official first-party source URLs and timestamps retained. This direct-add V2 editorial scoring preflight is NOT formal Stage A/B/C→Prompt 0.6/0.8 certification.
